 Advertisement Updated: 9:39 AM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Stephanie Moore Digital Content Manager Spartanburg Water issues systemwide boil water advisory
 Updated: 9:39 AM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Stephanie Moore Digital Content Manager SPARTANBURG, S.C. — Spartanburg Water is issuing a systemwide Boil Water Advisory for all customers in the main Spartanburg Water system (excluding Landrum) due to a significant loss of water pressure and/or service throughout the distribution system. 
 The water system said there has been no confirmed contamination of the system. 
 Advertisement Woman accused of packaging and weighing cocaine with children inside home However, as a precaution, Spartanburg Water is advising its customers to vigorously boil their water for at least one (1) full minute prior to drinking or cooking. 
 Greenville County leaders put AI facility proposal on hold Also, any ice made from water that has not been boiled should not be used for drinking purposes. 
 This advisory will remain in effect until further notice.
